svg.title: Nirvana CMS Admin Panel Storyboard
svg.desc: A polished colorful six-frame storyboard for a React CMS admin panel covering application selection, dashboard, content, page builder, taxonomy, and users settings.
svg.text: A React admin workflow from access to publishing, designed for quick scanning and confident actions.

g.text: Sharp layout, colorful status cues, compact CMS controls.
Admin starts from a calm app grid with status badges and direct entry points.
Website health, freshness, and editorial volume
Dense summary helps admins spot issues before entering lists.
Filter by status, scan rows, publish from context
Tables stay tidy with clear hierarchy, compact actions, and colored states.
Sections, components, and element editing in one workspace
Builder is split into navigation, canvas structure, and focused settings.
Categories and tags become a simple editorial map
Grouped chips and tidy counts make organization feel controlled, not crowded.
Permissions, roles, status, and destructive actions are separated
Access control is legible, with dangerous choices isolated visually.
Every screen gives the admin one primary action, visible state, and a clear path back to the application context.
